description: This file defines the class OAuth2AuthCodes, which manages OAuth 2.0 authorization codes within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties for database interaction, security controls, and methods for handling authorization code logic such as revocation, scope authorization, and query building.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodes
classes.description: Class representing OAuth2 authorization codes in SuiteCRM, providing methods for managing the life cycle of authorization codes, including revocation status and scope authorization.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a shortened summary string for the authorization code, based on its ID.

methods.name: is_revoked
methods.description: Determines if the authorization code has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: is_scope_authorized
methods.description: Checks whether the scope of a given OAuth2 authorization request is authorized based on stored data.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query for listing authorization codes, adding user-specific filtering if the current user is not an admin.
